description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), minimum damage 1, grants [Awoken Successor], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode (Fire, Earth)] and [Bestial Exodus] to the user

description.name: Awoken Successor
description.text: Fire and Earth abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire and Earth abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Fire, Earth)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/ [Attach Earth] after using a Fire/Earth ability

description.name: Bestial Exodus
description.text: Grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies after using a Fire or Earth ability
